item.title: What to know as Trump visits Xi in China
item.description: Trump has landed in Beijing for the first visit by a US leader since his own in 2017.

item.title: Trade, Iran and Taiwan on the agenda as Trump arrives in China for high-stakes talks with Xi
item.description: The US president says his first request to Xi would be to "open up" China, while Beijing is expected to press Trump on the status of Taiwan.

item.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 22 people, health ministry says
item.description: Eight children are among those reported dead after a series of air strikes hit the south of Beirut.

item.title: Rescuers search rubble of Kyiv flats after massive Russian strikes kill two
item.description: Children are among the injured after Russia launched drones and missiles across Ukraine, officials say.

item.title: 'They shot my neighbour in the head' - the lakeside city traumatised by war
item.description: Rebel fighters and Rwandan troops are accused of committing atrocities after capturing the DR Congo city of Uvira in December.

item.title: Gunshots fired in Philippine Senate where lawmaker wanted by ICC is holed up
item.description: Senator Ronald dela Rosa, a former police chief, enforced former President Rodrigo Duterte's deadly drug war.

item.title: 'Floating armoury' ship reportedly seized by Iran
item.description: A vessel said to be a “floating armoury” in the Gulf of Oman has been seized by Iranian military personnel, according to reports.

item.title: Warning of record global temperatures as chance of very strong El Niño grows
item.description: As El Niño develops this year, scientists are increasingly confident it could be one of the strongest on record with global consequences, as Simon King explains.
